payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details on how the proposed method differs from existing methods in multilingual vision-and-language tasks.

claims.text: Our method utilizes visually-aligned multilingual instructions to learn a cross-lingual language representation that captures visual semantics, unlike existing methods that primarily focus on text-image pairs or auxiliary tasks.
We focus on multi-lingual vision-and-language navigation, using navigation paths as a bridge between multilingual instructions, which is distinct from traditional tasks like VQA and captioning.
Our approach aims to learn an environment-agnostic visual representation, contrasting with methods that rely on data augmentation techniques for generalization.
